summary: Phase 1 + Phase 2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 35 new pytest cases covering Google-session (401 on invalid), user search, contact requests/list/block, file & image uploads to Emergent Object Storage, download auth (token required, non-participant rejected), attachment intelligence (find_amount / summarize / create_task) with source-cited results, global attachment search, groups CRUD (create/detail/add/remove/role/leave), group in /api/chats, group messaging, Group Brain summary, voice upload (Whisper), auth requirement on all new endpoints, and new privacy toggles (voice_messages, attachments, group_intelligence, images, documents). 34/35 passed = 97.1%. The single failure is a legitimate product issue: GET /api/contacts/list returns [] for the demo account because seeded bot personas (Rahul/Priya/Aman) are NOT written to the `contacts` collection (they only exist as users + seeded DMs). The older GET /api/contacts returns them because it lists all users. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): Login screen renders 'Continue with Google' button; New Chat shows 'New Group' entry + user search (typing 'Rahul' returns Rahul Sharma with Message button); New Group screen shows group-name-input and create-group-button; Privacy screen shows all 5 new toggles (Attachments, Image Analysis, Document Analysis, Voice Messages, Group Intelligence); Opened Rahul chat shows attach-button, voice-button, smart-reply-button, chat-brain-button; Tapping attach-button opens Share sheet with Camera / Photos / Document. No red-screen errors, no deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: Returns [] for demo@chatly.app account even though seeded bot personas (Rahul/Priya/Aman) exist and appear in /api/chats. The `contacts` collection is never populated for the demo user during seeding — only via /api/contacts/request accept flow. Recommendation: at seed time, insert bidirectional documents into `contacts` for demo <-> each bot, so the UI's Contacts screen (which likely reads /api/contacts/list) is not empty. Alternatively, frontend can fall back to /api/chats participants.

action_items: Seed the demo account's `contacts` collection with entries for the three seeded bot personas so GET /api/contacts/list is not empty on a fresh demo login (currently returns []).

(Optional) Consistency: the older GET /api/contacts endpoint returns ALL users (which is more like a directory) while the new GET /api/contacts/list returns actual accepted contacts. Consider unifying / renaming for clarity, or ensure the UI reads the correct one.
critical_code_review_comments: files_routes.py.download_file correctly requires a token and DB-verifies chat membership before serving bytes — good. 401 for missing/invalid token, 403 for non-participant, 404 for unknown path.
social_routes.py.send_request has clean idempotency + reverse-pending auto-accept path — good.
groups_routes.py.remove_member correctly blocks removing the owner (400) and requires admin (403). Non-member trying to view group returns 404 (obscures existence) — good.
files_routes.py MAX_FILE=25MB and DOC_EXT/IMAGE_MIMES allow-list is enforced — good.
ai/attachment prompt embeds file content and instructs LLM 'Never invent extracted information. If confidence is low, say so. Cite the source file.' — good hallucination guard.

chat_routes.py.list_contacts returns ALL users (not real contacts) — semantically inconsistent with social_routes.my_contacts (@/contacts/list). Consider renaming the older one to /api/users/directory.

success_rate.backend: 97.1% (34/35 Phase-1/2 tests passed; 1 legit product issue on demo seed for /api/contacts/list)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of Phase-1/2 UI surfaces verified (Google button on login, New Group entry, user-search, group create screen, privacy toggles, attach/voice/smart-reply buttons in chat, Share sheet with Camera/Photos/Document)

seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ artifacts during testing: TEST_invoice.txt attachment uploaded to Rahul DM, a 1x1 PNG image attachment, a TEST_ group with Rahul+Priya (later left), a TEST_voice.m4a voice message, and a task auto-created via /ai/attachment create_task action. All prefixed with TEST_ for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use demo@chatly.app / Demo1234. BASE_URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Phase-1/2 tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_phase12_features.py and run with pytest in ~50s (34/35 pass). Attachment intelligence + Group Brain call Sarvam AI — use generous timeouts (60-90s). Object storage (Emergent) is live and persists uploads. Voice upload accepts any bytes; Whisper may produce empty transcript for synthetic audio — that is intentionally tolerated by the spec. Google OAuth cannot be fully E2E automated; POST /api/auth/session with a random session_id correctly returns 401.
rca_of_issue: GET /api/contacts/list returns [] on demo account. RCA: The demo seed inserts users (bots) + chats + messages, but does NOT insert `contacts` collection docs. The new `/api/contacts/list` endpoint (social_routes.my_contacts) reads exclusively from the `contacts` collection, whereas the older `/api/contacts` (chat_routes.list_contacts) simply lists all users. Fix: in the demo-seed routine (wherever bots are created and DMs seeded), also do db.contacts.insert_many([...]) with both directions (demo->bot and bot->demo) for each seeded persona.
